name: ISO 3098 lettering
source: ISO 3098-1:2015 Technical product documentation - Lettering - Part 1: General requirements (replaces ISO 3098-0:1997; same clause structure). Values below read from ISO 3098-0:1997.
verifiedFrom: https://law.resource.org/pub/in/bis/S01/is.9609.0.2001.pdf (IS 9609 (Part 0):2001, identical with ISO 3098-0:1997: clauses 4 to 6, Tables 1 and 2)
https://cdn.standards.iteh.ai/samples/41378/68ad6243f3454770a6c125cd67de86c0/SIST-EN-ISO-3098-1-2015.pdf (ISO 3098-1:2015 preview: contents only, same clauses 4 to 6)
heightsSource: ISO 3098-0:1997, 5.3 Range of nominal sizes: '1,8 mm; 2,5 mm; 3,5 mm; 5 mm; 7 mm; 10 mm; 14 mm; 20 mm' (ratio sqrt(2), from ISO 216). The nominal size h is the height of the upper-case letters (5.1).
typesSource: ISO 3098-0:1997, 5.5, Table 1 (type A) and Table 2 (type B). Values are multiples of h. b1: lettering with diacritical marks; b2: upper and lower case without diacritical marks; b3: upper case only.

B.preferred: Type B vertical is marked 'preferred application' in 5.5.

spacingRule: Space between characters = twice the line width; may be reduced to one line width for combinations such as LA, TV or Tr (ISO 3098-0:1997, 4.1).
slope: Vertical, or inclined to the right at 75 degrees from the horizontal (ISO 3098-0:1997, 5.4).
lineWidthRule: Line widths per ISO 128-20 (now ISO 128-2); the same line width for upper and lower case (5.3). Type B: d = h/10, so 3.5 mm lettering uses 0.35 mm, a width of the ISO 128-2 series.

designation.example: Lettering ISO 3098 - BVL - 5 (type B, vertical, Latin, 5 mm)

default.origin: MechPilot's choice, not from the standard
default.gridReferenceSource: ISO 5457:1999, 4.4 (letters and numerals of the grid reference are 3,5 mm)
default.notes: ISO 129-1:2018, 4.1.7 requires one character height for all dimensions and tolerances on a drawing.

notes: The multiples are stored as fractions; the app computes h * fraction. The tabulated millimetre values in Tables 1 and 2 are those products (some rounded, e.g. type A line width 0,13 for h = 1,8).
Types CA and CB (for numerically controlled lettering, ISO 3098-5) are not used by MechPilot.
